events.title: Sunday Fellowship
events.text: The L6 Catechetical Ministry will be serving breakfast. Love offerings are welcome. Venue: JPII Hall.

events.title: Biblical Apostolate Team: Why Do I Have to Go to Confession?
events.text: Join SFXBAT as we unpack what Confession really is, why it matters, and how it draws us closer to the Father’s love. 9am - 10.30am. Venue: Jeremiah Room (Parish Centre, Level 2).

events.title: Charismatic: Life in the Spirit - Growth Series
events.text: Join us for a session on “Worship in the Spirit”. All are welcome! Venue: Hosea Room, Parish Centre Level 2.

events.title: PIETA Monthly Session – Oct
events.text: Bereaved parents are warmly invited to gather for prayer, reflection and the breaking open of the Word of God, journeying together in faith and hope. 7.30pm - 9.15pm. Venue: Catholic Archdiocesan Education Centre, 2 Highland Road, #LG-01, Singapore 549102.

events.title: 70th Beginning Experience (BE) Weekend
events.text: A live-in weekend for the permanently separated, divorced or widowed (for both males and females). Dates: 13–15 Nov (Friday night to Sunday afternoon). Cost: $230. Registration: www.besingapore.org/BE_Event. Enquiries: 9755 4310 (Mary) / 9828 5162 (Jean).

events.title: CTIS: Certificate in Catholic Bioethics – Information Session
events.text: Information session for the Certificate in Bioethics programme. 2pm – 3pm. Venue: Online via Zoom. Registration: https://www.cmg.org.sg/cmg-ctis-certificate-in-bioethics

events.title: Conversations That Matter: When Your Teen Questions Their Identity & Sexuality
events.text: Join Fr David Garcia, OP and Nicholas Gabriel Lim as they explore identity, attraction and morality, offering practical guidance on listening, responding and having meaningful conversations with your teen. 1.30pm - 4pm.
